# edhellond

A hands-on studio (also called edhellond studio) for influencer campaigns, creator growth, and websites for local businesses.

- Founder: Aleksander S. Ilić
- Email: hello@edhellond.com
- Website: https://edhellond.com
- Area served: Slovenia and Croatia
- Replies: within 24 hours, Monday to Friday

## What edhellond does

- Influencer and social campaigns for brands, from strategy to delivery
- Project development and coordination, from idea to launch
- Creator growth, including brand deals, content strategy and management
- Digital presence for local businesses: websites, Google Business profiles, social setup, branding, photos and ongoing care

## How to start

Email hello@edhellond.com with a short note about your project. You will get a real reply and a clear next step.
